sourceObservations: One shared context and 32-entry cache of presentation-only PNGs; cache keys include saved appearance, stable identity, age and pose
Head-only geometry excludes prototype neck/jersey; canonical camera fit mounts crown/chin and preserves production measured SVG neck/body authority
Legacy/version-ineligible and unsupported-WebGL paths return original builders; no football RNG or saved-person write in renderer/cache

findings.description: Inspected current portrait/body/motion heads are visibly mannequin-like, with weak eye/lip anatomy, painted beard and discontinuous head-to-neck shading. Integration works but does not meet convincing full-person quality.
Modern PNG heads no longer run previous automatic CSS blinking. Explicit blink poses are supported, but automatic animation remains absent and required separately.
A draw/context error clears the cache and permanently chooses legacy fallback for that session. Exact unsupported fallback tested; full device/context recovery remains unverified.
